content: Mbɔr abɛ
Mɛ amàlatööm Fɔ̈bɛ, mpääŋ abi, un'syääl a ndwà a Nzam ayà u Sanshrɛs.
Lun'wɛl unsà Mwol, asànaa yan'kwo ya akà aŋin'kyɛɛl, lun'bay unsà ndaa yanswà uyàkal nde anà mfun abɛ. Ntɔn nde kàkäl un'yee a baar mbɔɔn anà wà mɛ ŋakwo.
Lapɛ Priskà anà Akila mbɔr, mbaay amɛ unsà isal a Yɛsu Klistɔ,
ba bàkyer alàkwà ntɔn mukan'tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Kà mɛ mpɛl anki kàfuur an'tɔɔn, wɛɛ sye Ikööŋ a baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Làpɛ sye Ikööŋ byanswà ifàköŋ u ndwà aba mbɔr. Lun'pɛ nkween amɛ Ɛpɛnɛt mbɔr, mbɛŋ atàtwɛb yà Azi ntɔn Klistɔ.
Lun'pɛ Màlye mbɔr, nde kàsäl mbɔɔn ntɔn bɛ.
Lapɛ Andrɔnikis anà Yunyas mbɔr, aböör amɛ anà mbaay amɛ yà bɔlokà. Ba bà abyääl uboo a antööm, ba sye bàkäl amu Klistɔ kusà amɛ.
Lun'pɛ Ampilayatus mbɔr, mbuur amɛ wàntal uboo a Mwol.
Lun'pɛ Lubɛn mbɔr, un'baay abi amu Klistɔ anà nkween amɛ Stakis.
Lun'pɛ Apɛlɛ mbɔr, mbuur kàswɛŋ inääm ande amu Klistɔ. Lapɛ baar abà u ndwà a Aristɔbul mbɔr.
Lun'pɛ un'böör amɛ Erɔdyɔn mbɔr. Lapɛ baar abà u ndwà a Narsis abà uboo a Mwol mbɔr.
Lapɛ Trifɛn anà Trifɔs mbɔr, ba bàmɛn mpay ntɔn Mwol. Lun'pɛ nkween Pɛrsis mbɔr, nde kàdwä ndür unsà isal a Mwol.
Lun'pɛ Rufus mbɔr, awà bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l amu Mwol anà ngwän ande awà wàmɛ sye.
Làpɛ Asynkrit, Felɛgɔn, Ermɛs, Patrɔbas, Ermas, anà atɔŋ abà anà ba mbɔr.
Làpɛ Filɔlɔke anà Zuli, Nɛrɛ anà mpääŋ ande, Ɔlympas anà aŋin'kyɛɛl abà anà ba mbɔr.
Làpɛɛlà mbɔr a ndüür in'kyɛɛl bamwɛy anà bumwɛy. Ikööŋ byanswà byà Klistɔ byàmàlapà mbɔr.
Ndɛɛl a ntsüü
Mɛ amàlalɔɔm, atɔŋ, mukal kà igyɛɛŋ akà baar bàfàtwaal nkaabà anà bàfàbwiy aŋàlàkwikilà ndwaŋ mutɔn an'lɔɔŋ amà làwɛl bɛ. Làkäl u kwɛl an à ba.
Ntɔn baar aban bàfàsyääl anki Klistɔ, Mwol abi, wɛɛ an'bäl aba, anà, unsà ndaa aba yà ntsà anà an'yääm aba mà loor, màfàkur baar a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Baar banswà bàkyàyöb unkyeey abɛ. Lalan mɛ in'wà unsà un'sak ntɔn bɛ, wɛɛ mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làkäl aŋan'yeerà ntɔn ubwaŋ anà ankɔr ntɔn ube.
Yan'sal ikikye, Nzam a duu ayàbwanà Satanà ungyɛl a in'kɔl abɛ. Wɛy kab a ngway a Mwol abi Yɛsu làkäl anà bɛ!
Tumàtɛ, un'baay amɛ, kàmàlapà mbɔr, anà Lusyus, Yasɔn anà Sɔsipatrɔs, aböör amɛ.
Mɛ Tɛrtyus in'sɔnà un'kaan wà, mɛ amàlatööm mbɔr unsà Mwol.
Gäyus, mbuur kan'wɛl, anà Ikööŋ kyanswà ifàköŋ u ndwà ande kàmàlapà mbɔr. Erast, mbuur afàkaar ngim a bul lanswà kàmalapà mbɔr, anà un'tɔŋ Kartus.
Wɛy kab a ngway a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ làkäl anà bɛ banswà! Wöwö!
Làkoo là ntɔn Nzam mpɛl

Bi isyäŋà Nzam! Nde we anà ikɔ̈b mukàlapà ngwal asànaa làlɔɔmà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ in'fàkyään mɛ ntɔn Yɛsu Klistɔ, mulab ngyööb kàwɛl bi u ngyööŋ aŋàyee a Nzam. Ngyööŋ ayi yàkäl yàŋàyee itaan, taaŋ mbɔɔn,

wɛɛ apanà, ya bàkyàmɛɛy u pɛɛlà anà u ngyööb a baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a in'kaan a aŋangɔɔm anà mulab nswɛɛŋ a Nzam ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ntsüü. Ya bàkyàswaŋ akà in'sɛŋ myanswà, ntɔn mya myàsi làkwikilà amu Nde anà myun'syääl.
Wɛy làkoo làkäl akà Nzam awà Nde mpɛl ŋan'yeerà, u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ, u mbul a in'tye! Wöwö!
